**Changelog for gzh-10w-hot v1.0.1**

- Added concise English and Chinese README files to improve onboarding and clarify usage scenarios.
- Removed six detailed reference and documentation files, including usage examples, workflow, output specs, and skill card, streamlining resources and reducing project complexity.
- Core skill description and operating instructions are now consolidated directly in SKILL.md.
- Guidance on API Key configuration and data sourcing moved upfront for easier integration.
- All key rules, time handling, output format, and HTML/PDF export specs are now provided as a single source of truth in SKILL.md.

Initial release of wechat-10w-hot skill:

- Provides daily updates of over 1000+ WeChat articles with 10w+ reads across all categories.
- Identifies user intent to fetch daily top 10w+ articles or domain-specific hot articles.
- Calls a Python script to fetch, sort, and output articles; displays script output directly to the user.
- Supports HTML leaderboard generation (strict visual style) and PDF export in one-page adaptive mode.
- Includes robust date logic to ensure correct time window for article retrieval, with clear user prompts when timespan mismatches occur.
- Automatically displays article summaries, full details, and offers subscription guidance at the end.
